author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Has Adam Savage ever worked with someone who was so self important they needed total control? What's the most "I can't believe that worked!" tool Adam made to fix another tool? In this live stream excerpt Adam answers this question from Tested members gideonschoepp8216 and HugoDahl, whom we thank for their support! What's your bad boss or bad co-worker story?
